evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC request and HTTP RPC error handling in src/httprpc.cpp and src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an assertion failure in debug builds and restores JSON-RPC 2.0 spec compliance on malformed requests. In debug builds, an Assume check fails and crashes the node on authenticated malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests, while release builds return HTTP 400 instead of HTTP 200.
